scripts.dev: NODE_ENV=development pnpm wasm:build && NODE_ENV=development vite dev
scripts.build: NODE_ENV=production pnpm wasm:build && NODE_ENV=production vite build
scripts.check: NODE_ENV=development pnpm wasm:build && NODE_ENV=development svelte-kit sync && NODE_ENV=development svelte-check --tsconfig ./tsconfig.json
